allow: PowerShell(npx -y skills add mindrally/skills --skill framer-motion --agent claude-code)
PowerShell(npm view uipro name version description dist.tarball 2>$null)
PowerShell(npm view uipro-cli bin repository homepage version --json)
PowerShell(npm view ui-ux-pro-max-cli bin repository homepage version --json)

PowerShell($s='animate','animation-vocabulary','apple-design','emil-design-eng','find-animation-opportunities','improve-animations','pick-ui-library','prototype','review-animations'; foreach\($n in $s\){ $p=".claude/skills/$n"; $f=Get-ChildItem $p -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $has=Test-Path "$p/SKILL.md"; "{0,-30} SKILL.md={1,-5} files={2}" -f $n,$has,$f.Count }; "---- scripts outside markdown ----"; Get-ChildItem .agents/skills -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'impeccable' -and $_.Extension -notin '.md','.json','.txt' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName)
PowerShell(npm view impeccable name version description bin --json 2>$null)

PowerShell($diff = Compare-Object \(Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\settings.local.before.json"\) \(Get-Content .claude/settings.local.json\); if \($diff\) { $diff | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200 } else { "settings.local.json UNCHANGED" }; "---- git status ----"; git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | Select-Object -First 20)

PowerShell($s='brandkit','industrial-brutalist-ui','gpt-taste','image-to-code','imagegen-frontend-mobile','imagegen-frontend-web','minimalist-ui','full-output-enforcement','redesign-existing-projects','high-end-visual-design','stitch-design-taste','design-taste-frontend','design-taste-frontend-v1'; foreach\($n in $s\){ $p=".claude/skills/$n"; $f=Get-ChildItem $p -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $kb=[math]::Round\(\($f|Measure-Object Length -Sum\).Sum/1KB,1\); "{0,-28} SKILL.md={1,-5} files={2,-3} {3} KB" -f $n,\(Test-Path "$p/SKILL.md"\),$f.Count,$kb }; "---- non-markdown payloads ----"; foreach\($n in $s\){ Get-ChildItem ".claude/skills/$n" -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Extension -notin '.md' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName })

PowerShell(if \(Test-Path .claude/launch.json\) { Get-Content .claude/launch.json -Raw } else { "NO launch.json" }; "---- scripts ----"; \(Get-Content package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json\).scripts | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
